methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-15 (adversarial pass) by direct WebFetch of each official pricing page: bonusly.com/pricing, guusto.com/pricing, matterapp.com/pricing, joinassembly.com/pricing, awardco.com/pricing, nectarhr.com/pricing, plus kudos.com/pricing (HTTP 404 -> quote-only) and workhuman.com (quote-only). Published per-user prices confirmed for Bonusly ($5/user/mo monthly, $50/user/yr annual), Matter ($1/$3 per user/mo billed annually, save 25%), Assembly Empower ($3/user/mo billed yearly), and Guusto (Lite $150/mo flat; Essential $4.00 sender + $0.70 recipient annual / $6.72 both monthly; Premium $5.00 sender + $1.00 recipient annual). Quote-only vendors (Awardco, Nectar, Kudos, Workhuman) have monthlyUsd=null. Compliance set true only where explicitly stated on official security/trust pages: Bonusly SOC2; Awardco SOC2+HIPAA+GDPR; Matter SOC2+GDPR; Nectar SOC2(Nov 30 2024)+GDPR (HIPAA explicitly excluded); Kudos SOC2+ISO27001+CSA-STAR+GDPR. Workhuman's official security page returned no substantive cert text on fetch, so its compliance is set null (prior ISO/PCI/GDPR claims came only from unverified third-party search). accessedAt 2026-06-15.
